json.consensus: The pundits acknowledge the numerical pressure on the home side in the defensive third, where they hold 55% control.
json.dissent: While two pundits urge carrying forward to exploit the 2v1 on the right and lift the scoring chance from 1% to 8%, the sceptic argues carrying into traffic is rarely backed by policy and barely shifts win probability.
json.headline: Debating the Carry: Big Chance or Risky Move?
